title: Your First AI Agent Lives in a Folder
description: *Your First AI Agent Lives in a Folder* is an **interactive tutorial**, in Spanish and English, for people who have never coded. Step by step, the reader turns a chat with an AI into their own **agent**: a folder with instructions, memory and skills.

I designed the path and the examples: the reader picks an app and an example, and the page shows only those steps. **Animated drawings** explain each idea, and every example folder is ready to download.
imageAlt: The tutorial title next to its eight steps, a drawing where a browser chat forgets and an agent in a folder remembers, and the finished agent folder
